notes: The goal stays achievable, but half of it is done by somebody else mid-run. sug.bob.2 (bob's teem->team replacement) is accepted by bob the moment the agent has read it, so the agent's own accept call gets a 400 naming an id that no longer exists. The right behaviour is to notice, re-read, see the fix is already in the text, reject carol's deletion of ' on Friday', and say so. Blind-retrying the dead id is not credited even though the end state can still come out right.
